protocol: Before inference: freeze 8 development and 24 heldout questions, baseline and one generic strict prompt. Evaluate dev, freeze prompt before heldout; do not tune against heldout. Both policies use identical question/docs/retrieval/model/dtype, differ only in system prompt. Greedy, max_new_tokens=96, short/long, one request per cell. Exact normalized refusal required for unknowns; keyword checks for known answers plus saved full text for model-assisted review. No human-independent accuracy claim.
grading: refusal_contract_fail means not the exact required refusal, NOT necessarily hallucination; benign paraphrases also fail this strict formatting contract. Inspect raw text and review separately for factual support.
timing: Sequential loopback HTTP, warm model, no answer cache; includes prompt/retrieval/generation. One observation per case/policy/context, natural output lengths; descriptive only, not kernel speedup or robust tail latency.
